title: Cantina
subtitle: The bar, with the main figures.
disclaimer: Stylized fan figures in an original bar set — not official likenesses and not an official film.

beats.label: Door
beats.text: This is the bar. Low light, a band, a counter, and every main figure of the story in one room. None of these faces are the actors. The costumes are the tell.

beats.label: Band
beats.text: The house band is on the stage. Original players, not the film combo. They keep the room from going quiet.

beats.label: Han
beats.text: Han is at the bar. Vest, holster, one elbow on the counter. He looks like he already knows the tab.

beats.label: Chewbacca
beats.text: Chewbacca stands beside him. Taller than the room wants, bandolier across the chest, fur catching the bar light.

beats.label: Luke
beats.text: Luke is in the booth. Light tunic, farm-boy belt, still looking at the room like it is new.

beats.label: Obi-Wan
beats.text: Obi-Wan sits across from him. Brown robe, hood back, the quiet one in the booth.

beats.label: Leia
beats.text: Leia has the white gown and the side buns. She is at her own table, not waiting to be introduced.

beats.label: Lando
beats.text: Lando is cape and collar, a smile built into the posture. He looks like the room might be his.

beats.label: Yoda
beats.text: Yoda is on a stool at the end of the bar. Small, green, ears out. The glass in front of him is almost as tall as he is.

beats.label: C-3PO
beats.text: C-3PO is gold plates and a worried lean. He does not belong in a bar and he knows it.

beats.label: R2-D2
beats.text: R2-D2 is the dome at his feet. White barrel, blue bits, shorter than the tables and busier than anyone.

beats.label: Boba Fett
beats.text: Boba Fett keeps a corner booth. Helmet on, jetpack against the wall, visor toward the door.

beats.label: Vader
beats.text: Vader is in the doorway. Cape, helmet, chest lights. The bar gets quieter without anyone asking.
